CustomField.description: - Total Revenue for Report Direct Sales, SME, Media Seller - this field calculated by amount which triggered (Trigger_Usage_After_Insert)
CustomField.formula: IF( OR( ISNULL(Total_Adjustment__c ), ISBLANK(Total_Adjustment__c ) ), Actual_Report__c, Total_Adjustment__c + Actual_Report__c )
CustomField.label: Adjustment + Amount
